name: shared-label-contract
goal: Harness EntityHeader contract excludes the removed shared badge input

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The UI implementation removed the EntityHeader.shared prop and its Shared badge, but the registered EntityHeader contract still documents that input; the user-visible contract page would remain inaccurate.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing explorer tests cover rendered badge removal and audio tabs, but no assertion ties EntityHeader's declared contract inputs to its current Svelte props; add a focused regression assertion for the stale input and its badge description.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At a913fc49b55596f6faa9d8a5c6a1024cfce30dd2, the unchanged explorer-screens unit regression failed because the registered EntityHeader contract still included EntityHeader.shared. The red run was recorded with loop record --phase red under the pinned environment.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The minimal repair is committed separately as 70d195aa6d918343ffd03172efb8a9f6b107889a: removed only the obsolete shared input from the EntityHeader unit contract, preserving the shared flag removal guard.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At 70d195aa6d918343ffd03172efb8a9f6b107889a, the exact unchanged regression passed: bun run --cwd packages/reports test:unit -- test/components/explorer-screens.test.ts (7 tests). The green run was recorded under the same pinned environment as red.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Focused Reports unit regression: bun run --cwd packages/reports test:unit -- test/components/explorer-screens.test.ts passed (7 tests); Prettier check passed for the regression test and unit contract. Browser flow loaded the EntityHeader Contract tab at the branch tip, rendered exactly four input rows (Entity, Nav, Preview, Owner), no Shared input, and no console/page errors. Fresh inspected screenshot saved at /tmp/harness-contract-shared-label-removed.png. The full Harness CLI suite was skipped as requested.
